_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG101 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.plan_basis: cgpg_split_proposals.json PG101 (consistency review: needs-review, minor - resolved here by the explicit locus-293 exclusion). Credited works tlg4040.015/017/018/019/026 are not in the served columns and get no range
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG101.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG101.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG101.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.

works.title: Amphilochia (Migne main series: prooemium + quaestiones I-CCCXXI+, truncated)

incipit_checks.incipit: Τῆς σπουδῆς σου τὸ γνήσιον δυσωπηθεὶς τὴν σὴν ἀοῆκα πρὸς πέρας ἐλθεῖν, ὡς ἐλπίσας, αἴτησιν·

works.evidence: Title line at col 44: ΦΩΤΙΟΥ ΠΑΤΡΙΑΡΧΟΥ ΚΩΝΣΤΑΝΤΙΝΟΥΠΟΛΕΩΣ ΠΡΟΣ ΑΜΦΙΛΟΧΙΟΝ ΤΟΝ ΟΣΙΩΤΑΤΟΝ ΜΗΤΡΟΠΟΛΙΤΗΝ ΚΥΖΙΚΟΥ ... ΖΗΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΔΙΑΦΟΡΩΝ; ΕΡΩΤΗΣΙΣ Α at col 45 (with subtitle 'Ἀμφιλόχια πρὸς Ἀμφιλόχιον μητροπολίτην Κυζίκου λόγων ἱερῶν συλλογή'); continuous ΕΡΩΤΗΣΙΣ numbering tracked A' (45) → ΤΙΖ (610) → Latin QUAESTIO CCCXXI garbled as ΟΟΣΘΤΙΟ ΟΩΩΧΧΙ at 611; matches standard reference Amphilochia = PG 101, 45-1172. Col 611 ends with the garbled heading of the next quaestio (~CCCXXII); the series' end falls in the unserved gap 612-619. No TLG id: the tlg4040 canon has no Amphilochia/Epistulae work (Laourdas-Westerink not in TLG-E).
works.notes: served locus 293 (Latin divider) is excluded to the residual per the consistency review

works.title: Commentarii in Matthaeum (in catenis) - Migne/Mai fragment series

incipit_checks.incipit: Ἀβραὰμ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἰσαάκ. 2ωτίου. Ἀβραὰμ διὰ πίστεως ἐδικαιώθη.

works.evidence: Col 620 opens with the Mt 1:2 lemma followed by a Φωτίου scholion; catena format with repeated Φωτίου attribution markers runs 620-630 in Matthew lemma order (Mt 9:17 wineskins at 625, Mt 26:75 cock-crow harmonization with Mark at 630). Section title lost in unserved gap 612-619. The served Migne/Mai text only partially overlaps the Reuss edition used by TLG.

works.title: Fragmenta in Marcum (in catenis)

incipit_checks.incipit: Καὶ παράγων, εἶδε Λευὶ τὸν τοῦ Ἀλφαίου καθήμενον ἐπὶ τὸ τελώνιον·

works.evidence: Col 631 lemmata are distinctively Marcan: Λευὶ τὸν τοῦ Ἀλφαίου (Mk 2:14), Herod/Baptist's head given τῷ κορασίῳ (Mk 6:28); col 632 has σπεκουλάτωρ (Mk 6:27) and Δεῦτε ὑμεῖς αὐτοὶ κατ' ἰδίαν ... ἀναπαύεσθε ὀλίγον (Mk 6:31, Mark only). No Photius in Marcum work exists in the TLG canon. Boundary with the Luke block falls mid-col 632.
works.notes: shared boundary row 632 (Mark block end + Luke block start) is assigned to the Luke fragments

works.title: Fragmenta in Lucam (in catenis)

incipit_checks.incipit: Ἐπεὶ οὖν ἀγράφων ὄντων τῶν παραδιδομένων, εἰκὸς ἦν ἄτοπα πολλὰ συμβαίνειν

works.evidence: Begins mid-col 632 with commentary on Luke's prologue (οἱ ἀπὸ τῶν αὐτοπτῶν καὶ ὑπηρετῶν τοῦ Λόγου = Lk 1:2), preceded by garbled heading ΙΝ ΗΟΑΜ (likely IN LUCAM); then Annunciation Lk 1:28-38 (633-636, Γενηθήτω μοι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου at 636), Magnificat Lk 1:51 (634), Simeon Lk 2:34 (637), baptism (638), Joseph of Arimathea and burial (638-639), harmonistic scholia on the resurrection appearances defending Jerusalem appearances against the Galilee promise (639-640, quoting Mt 27:52 and Mt 28). Attribution of 638-640 to the Luke section (Lk 23-24 harmonization) rather than Matthew is my best reading; the content is partly Matthaean.

works.title: Commentarii in Joannem (in catenis) - Migne/Mai fragment series

incipit_checks.incipit: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Πᾶς ἀ πίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος τούτου, διψήσει πάλιν·

works.evidence: Col 641 opens with the Jn 4:13 lemma (Samaritan woman) with Φωτίου scholia; Jn 17:11-13 commentary at 642 head. Only ~1.5 columns served; the section ends mid-col 642 where Romans commentary begins. Far smaller than the Reuss corpus TLG serves for this work.
works.notes: shared boundary row 642 (John tail + Romans start) is assigned to the Romans fragments

works.title: Fragmenta in epistulam ad Romanos (in catenis) - Migne/Mai fragment series

incipit_checks.incipit: Εἰπών οὖν, ὡς ἔφημεν, ὅτι τύπος ἦν ὁ Ἀδὰμ τοῦ Χριστοῦ·

works.evidence: Begins mid-col 642 (Rom 5:14 τύπος fragment; col head is still John 17). Romans lemma order confirmed across the block: Rom 5:17-18 at 643, Rom 7:8-10 at 643-646, Rom 8:24 at 646, Rom 8:31-9:3 at 647, Rom 9:11 at 648, Rom 11 at 649, Rom 12:2 at 650, Rom 14:6-9 at 652. Ends mid-col 652 at the printed heading of the next section.
works.notes: shared boundary row 652 (Romans end + 2 Cor heading) is assigned to the 2 Corinthians fragments

incipit_checks.incipit: Ἡ γὰρ κατὰ Θεὸν λύπη μετάνοιαν εἰς σωτορία κατεργάζεται.

works.evidence: Printed section heading mid-col 652 OCR'd as 'ΙΙ. ΙΝ ΕΡΙΘΤΟΙΑΜ ΙΙ ΑΒ ΟΟΗΙΝΤΗΙΟΘ' = 'II. IN EPISTOLAM II AD CORINTHIOS' (with a garbled Mai page citation), followed immediately by 2 Cor 7:10 commentary. Only the tail of col 652 is served; the work continues into the unserved gap 653-663.

works.title: Amphilochia, supplementum: fuller recensions of selected quaestiones

incipit_checks.incipit: ΕΡΩΡΗΣΙΣ ΡΜΗʹ. εἶδε ἀλλήλους δάκνετε καὶ κατεσθίετε, Ελέπετε μὴ ὑπ´ ἀλλήλων ἀναλωθῆτε

works.evidence: Col 664 opens with ΕΡΩΤΗΣΙΣ ΡΜΗʹ (148, on Gal 5:13-15); then ΕΡΩΤΗΣΙΣ headings at 665 (Διὰ τί ὁ Υἱὸς ἐσαρκώθη..., number garbled), 667 ΣΚΗʹ (Περὶ φύσεως καὶ ὑποστάσεως), 669 ΣΛʹ (Περὶ θεότητος), 671 ΣΛΑʹ, 672 ΤΙΘʹ (Absalom) and ΤΚʹ (φοιβήσασθαι), 673 ΤΚΑʹ (the raven and Elijah). Qq. 320-321 duplicate, with fuller answers, the same questions printed at col 611 in the main series, proving this is a supplementary recension, not a continuation. Its section title lies in the unserved gap 653-663. Same NEW work identity as the Amphilochia main series.

residual.note: 14-15: Greek excerpts quoted inside the Latin prolegomena (from Nicetas David Paphlagon's Vita Ignatii, PG 105); 293: the garbled Latin divider heading (ΒΙΘΘΕΛΤΑΤΙΟ = DISSERTATIO) inside the Amphilochia range, excluded per the consistency review's locus-293 rule
